text:
Sr Animator will be responsible for overall animation quality of multiple projects under him/her. These projects can range from Character Animation to mix media videos. Depending on the project and client, s/he will need to work directly on the production or help other animator/editor to deliver high quality on time. It will also involve coordinating with freelancers, vendors as well as internal resources like junior animator, illustrator, Art Director and producer for delivery. 
 Compensation: Rs 50000 pm

• Needs to be proficient at entire Adobe suite. 

 - Excellent Motion graphics skills 
 - Decent Character animation skills

• 4+ years of relevant work experience in delivering explainers, social media ads etc.
- Easy to work and collaborate with. Should come across as a friendly, warm person. 
- Should be patient with receiving and giving feedback. 
- keeps track of marketing, video and animation trends and techniques. 
- comfortable with using Presets, AE widgets to delivery better quality faster. 
- enjoys mentoring and developing other resources. 

 Compensation: Rs 50000 pm
 Company will provide delivery of a high end desktop system to work on. 
 Your internet bill will be compensated. 
 First salary review at 6 months of joining. 
 Studio Dialogbox is 3 year old video production company based out of mumbai. We specialize in creating social media ads, explainers, Demos, testimonials and other video content for various business needs. We across multiple mediums - Live action, animation and mix media. Our growing team is highly experienced in video production workflow, skilled in their respective domains and caring of each other.
